reasoning: The repository holds detector microservices for the FMS Guardrails Orchestrator. Each one is a FastAPI/uvicorn HTTP server that exposes the IBM Detector API (e.g. /api/v1/text/contents) and Prometheus /metrics. There are three: huggingface (sequence classification / Granite Guardian models), llm_judge (vLLM Judge, LLM-as-a-judge) and builtIn (regex/PII, file-type and custom Python detectors). Each detector has its own Dockerfile that builds a container image running uvicorn on a port. The huggingface detector also ships KServe ServingRuntime and InferenceService manifests so it can run as an inference service, and Tekton/Konflux pipelines build the runtime images. The repo has no CRDs or reconcilers, so it is not an operator. It ships deployable network services rather than a reusable package, so it is not a library. The shared detectors/common module is only internal scaffolding for those services.
